design.name: 举父
design.weapon: a lightning-cracked boulder lifted over its head with both hands
design.brief: The Jufu (举父) of Chongwu Mountain in the Shan Hai Jing, 'like a macaque with patterned arms, tiger- and leopard-like, good at throwing': a hunched, powerful ape about 1.9 m tall with very long thick arms in a knuckle-walking stance, a small fierce face with a short snout, golden-brown shaggy fur on the shoulders and back, and bold tiger-like black-and-amber STRIPES on both long arms. The boulder it throws is cracked with glowing magenta-violet lightning veins (the weak spot while it is lifted); a glowing magenta palm print on its chest. Big hands, each with a clearly visible thumb and four fingers. Cunning brute thrower. NOT a gorilla: a lean-hipped macaque with striped arms.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the earlier rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, huodou sighthound): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Lightning is painted as OPAQUE glowing magenta-violet zig-zag veins and solid sculpted spark shapes on the body (never transparent bolts, particles, smoke or glow halos); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps.
design.turnaround_pose: standing upright on its two legs like a big macaque, the back slightly hunched, the very long striped arms hanging a little away from the body, BOTH HANDS EMPTY and open (NO boulder: the boulder is a separate prop), palms facing the thighs, fingers relaxed and apart; the feet flat on the ground and shoulder-width apart; the head facing straight ahead with the mouth closed; the glowing magenta palm print on its chest painted opaque (no halo); MODELLING BASE STATE WITH EFFECTS SEPARATED: nothing glows and nothing emits light anywhere: no bloom, no halo, no light spill on the surrounding fur, no sparks, no electric arcs, and no crystal-like or spark-shaped spikes sticking out of the body (all of those are added later as game effects); every lightning vein is only a thin FLAT painted magenta line on the surface, like a tattoo, with crisp edges and the same matte lighting as the rest of the body; the eyes are flat painted colour; the palm print on its chest is a flat painted magenta mark
design.turnaround_digits: each hand with a clearly separate thumb and four fingers, countable; each foot with a separate big toe and four toes.
